name: mundial-qa-automation
description: QA automation project testing [Mundial2026](https://pgmondial2026.netlify.app) (a World Cup 2026 score-prediction app: React + Vite + Supabase) from the outside. Covers UI (Playwright/Python), API, SQL data validation, AI-assisted bug reporting, and CI/CD.

scripts.env:up: docker compose --env-file .env.docker up -d --build db rest gateway web && node scripts/clean-test-users.mjs
